blocks.text: You can create and manage provisioning keys for your Network Connectors in the Zscaler Admin Console. These keys are used to enroll a Network Connector and associate it with the correct group.
To add a Network Connector provisioning key:

blocks.item: Go to Private Access > VPN (for Legacy Apps) > Network Connector Provisioning Keys.
The Add Network Connector Provisioning Key page appears.
On the Add Network Connector Provisioning Key page:

View or Export Provisioning Key After Creation: Disable to hide the provisioning key from the Provisioning Key column on the Network Connector Provisioning Keys page. This also disables the ability to copy or download the key after creation. If disabled, you cannot enable this option after you save the provisioning key. This option is enabled by default.
Group: Select a Network Connector group to associate with this provisioning key.
Name: Enter a name for the provisioning key. The name cannot contain special characters, with the exception of periods (.), hyphens (-), and underscores ( _ ).

Signing Certificate: Select the signing certificate (i.e., enrollment (CA) certificate) for this provisioning key. All Network Connectors deployed with this key will have their certificates signed with this signing certificate. You can click Clear to remove the current selection.
The provisioning key is displayed. You can copy the key for use during deployment.
